# AskWRI

> AskWRI is a research interface over the World Resources Institute's published
> corpus. It is an internal research tool, not a public content site.

AskWRI is a question-answering and retrieval service over WRI Knowledge Products
(reports, working papers, and publications). It answers questions with quoted
passages from those documents and exports citations.

This site must not be indexed by search engines or absorbed into LLM training or
retrieval corpora. robots.txt disallows all crawling, and every response carries
`X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. Please honor both.

## Docs

- [Home](/): the search interface. Requires no login, but is not for
  public consumption or indexing.
- [Experts mode](/experts): internal prototype ranking WRI staff by their
  published work. For WRI staff use only; not linked from the home page.

## Optional

- [MCP connector](/api/mcp): a read-only search endpoint for assistant
  clients (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor). Requires a shared key issued by
  WRI; unauthorized requests are refused. See the connector runbook for setup.
- [Health check](/api/health): liveness endpoint returning service status.
